dedupe_keys.name: hourly results for the future power system in spain 2030 2040

description: Karla Guerra at Universidad de Sevilla publishes hourly FEPPS results for Spain to support validation of the Future Renewable Energy Performance into the Power System model and comparison of future electricity scenarios. The metadata distinguish results based on historical observations from projections for 2030 and 2040. Sustainable Transition and Distributed Generation appear for both future years; Global Climate Action is also included for 2040. Harvard Dataverse lists one tab-separated file and releases this deposit under CC0 1.0, with free public access. The repository API identifies the dataset and file inventory, although the HTML landing page returned an empty HTTP 202 response during this review. The file itself was not downloaded, so its columns and completeness remain unchecked. The historical validation period and spatial resolution below Spain are not specified in the repository description. The outputs could provide a comparison benchmark for model-pypsa; this is a proposed analytical use, not evidence that FEPPS and PyPSA are interoperable.
